tool_input.description: Check Locale constructor null-country behavior on this JDK
Write and run scratch Java program to check Locale constructor null handling

result:
Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/LocaleUtilsAgentTest.java` (49 tests, all passing) covering `LocaleUtils`'s full public and package-private API: cached/unmodifiable locale list/set, `countriesByLanguage`/`languagesByCountry` filtering and caching, `isAvailableLocale`, `isLanguageUndetermined`, `localeLookupList` variant/country/duplicate handling, `toLocale(Locale)` default-locale fallback, and extensive `toLocale(String)` parsing including dash/underscore separators, numeric area codes, the `th_TH_TH`/`ja_JP_JP` special cases, and boundary/malformed-input error cases.

One note: the sandbox blocked a couple of ad-hoc scratch Bash commands (heredocs with braces) I tried to use to empirically verify JDK `Locale` constructor null-handling before writing the `ofCountry(null)` test — I relied on documented JDK behavior instead, and the resulting test passes.
